charts.title: TOI-663 c: orbits around TOI-663
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-663's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-663 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Cointepas et al. 2024 (2024A&A...685A..19C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname COINTEPAS_ET_AL__2024): P 4.6955507 d

charts.title: TOI-663 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-663 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (62, 89, 100) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 54962195, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 16 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 18 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 16 min late; 9-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 6 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
